title: Glioblastoma
blurb: Glioblastoma, WHO grade 4. Dense, pleomorphic astrocytic tumour cells in a pink fibrillary background, with areas of haemorrhage.

title: Lung Adenocarcinoma
blurb: Invasive adenocarcinoma. Malignant glands replace the alveolar spaces of normal lung. The fine cracks across the section come from tissue processing.

title: Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma
blurb: Squamous cell carcinoma. Nests of polygonal tumour cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm infiltrate the lung parenchyma.

title: Clear Cell Renal Carcinoma
blurb: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Nests of cells with clear cytoplasm, separated by a fine network of thin-walled blood vessels.

title: Colon Adenocarcinoma
blurb: Colonic adenocarcinoma. Normal crypts along one edge give way to irregular, back-to-back malignant glands.

title: Invasive Breast Carcinoma
blurb: Invasive breast carcinoma. Dense tumour infiltrates between lobules of adipose tissue, which appear white on H&E.

title: Rectal Adenocarcinoma
blurb: Rectal adenocarcinoma. Complex and cribriform malignant glands set in desmoplastic stroma.

title: Cutaneous Melanoma
blurb: Cutaneous melanoma. The epidermis runs along the outer edge of the section, with tumour cells invading the dermis beneath it.

title: Gastric Adenocarcinoma
blurb: Gastric adenocarcinoma. Two tissue fragments joined by tumour, with residual gastric mucosa at the surface.

title: Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
blurb: Papillary thyroid carcinoma. Branching papillae lined by cells with pale, overlapping nuclei.

title: Prostate Adenocarcinoma
blurb: Prostatic adenocarcinoma. Small, crowded malignant glands infiltrate between benign glands. This architecture is what Gleason grading scores.

title: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
blurb: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Infiltrating malignant ducts in dense fibrotic stroma, beside fat and congested vessels.

title: High-Grade Serous Ovarian Carcinoma
blurb: High-grade serous carcinoma of the ovary. Highly cellular fragments with slit-like spaces and papillary architecture.
